sections.title: What this site is — and is not
sections.intro: In short: proudtek.com is a manufacturer's information site, not a storefront — reading these terms is faster once you know that.
bullets: It describes Proud Tek's RFID and NFC manufacturing, its product families, and the technical background you need to scope a project.
There are no user accounts and no on-site payments. A form creates a business inquiry, nothing more — the Privacy Policy covers how that data is handled.
Product pages, price indications and capability claims are an invitation to inquire, not a binding offer. A commitment exists only in a written quote, sales contract or proforma invoice.
By using the site you accept these terms; if you are inquiring for a company, you confirm you may do so.

sections.title: Content accuracy and ordering
sections.intro: In short: treat every spec here as scoping information. We keep it current on a review cycle, but chips get superseded between reviews — so confirm what matters in writing before you order.
bullets: Specifications, certifications and compatibility statements can change without notice and may lag a vendor's latest datasheet revision.
Confirm any specification that matters to your deployment in writing before ordering; for high-stakes deployments, verify with your own samples.
Quotes, lead times, tolerances and warranties are governed by the sales contract or proforma invoice for that transaction. If a website page and your contract disagree, the contract wins.
Confirmed errors in published content are corrected in the open at /about/corrections/.

callout.label: Website terms ≠ purchase terms
callout.text: These terms govern your use of proudtek.com. The commercial terms of a purchase — price, specs, delivery, warranty, liability — live in the sales contract or proforma invoice you sign. How and how often we review published specs is set out in our editorial policy.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.intro: In short: three layers of ownership sit on this site — our content, third-party images, and third-party trademarks — and each keeps its own rules.
bullets: Site content — text, page layouts, photography we produced, and data we measured — is © Proud Tek Co., Limited. Quote it with a link; ask at info@proudtek.com before republishing a page wholesale.
Third-party images are used under their own licenses and credited where they appear; those licenses govern any reuse.

Third-party trademarks (MIFARE and NTAG for NXP's chip families, RAIN RFID, and the lock- and reader-brand names we cite) stay their owners' and identify the products discussed only — the full trademark disclosure is at /about/disclosures/.
Machine-readable mirrors (llms.txt, /machine/ routes) let AI systems cite a claim with a working link back — citation with attribution is welcome.

sections.title: External links
sections.intro: In short: we link out to primary sources — standards bodies, datasheets, regulators — but those destinations aren't ours.
bullets: Linked third-party sites are outside our control; we are not responsible for their content, availability or terms.
A link is a citation, not an endorsement.
If a source we cite no longer says what our article claims, report it to info@proudtek.com and we will review it.

sections.title: No warranty, limitation of liability
sections.intro: In short: the website is provided as is, and decisions made on website content alone are at your own risk — which is exactly why we tell buyers to confirm specs in writing.
bullets: The site and its content are provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied, as to accuracy, completeness or fitness for a particular purpose.
To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Proud Tek is not liable for losses arising from reliance on website content, from site unavailability, or from third-party sites we link to.
Nothing here limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law, or the commercial warranties agreed in a signed sales contract — those are governed by that contract.
We may update the site and these terms at any time; the modified date on this page reflects the current version.

Raise any dispute or question about these terms with us first at info@proudtek.com — most issues are resolved by correspondence.

faq.question: Do these terms govern my purchase order?
faq.answer: No. These terms cover use of the website only. Every quote, sample and order is governed by the individual sales contract or proforma invoice agreed for that transaction — including price, specifications, delivery, warranty and liability.

faq.question: Can I rely on a spec published on this site when ordering?
faq.answer: Treat published specs as scoping information. Chips get superseded and datasheets revised between our review cycles, so confirm any specification that matters in writing before ordering, and verify with your own samples for high-stakes deployments.

faq.question: Can I reuse text or images from proudtek.com?
faq.answer: Site content is © Proud Tek Co., Limited — quote it with a link, and ask at info@proudtek.com before republishing anything wholesale. Third-party images are credited where they appear and keep their own licenses, which govern any reuse.

faq.question: Questions about these terms?
faq.answer: Email info@proudtek.com or use the contact page at /contact/. For privacy questions — what data the site collects and your rights over it — see the Privacy Policy at /about/privacy-policy/.
